linux_transport_failure_2026_09_15.finding: The native transport check failed while the narrow Inbox window had completed 37 actions and was waiting on thread-back. The prior helper discarded lsof exit code, output and process status. The retained artifacts cannot establish whether a TCP socket or inspection error caused the refusal. No passing rerun is claimed to explain it.
linux_transport_failure_2026_09_15.followup: Keep rejecting every unexpected lsof outcome. Record process index/PID/exit status, inspector return code and bounded stdout/stderr in the exception and capture/transport-failure.json. Preserve partial timeout output. Workflow result records the exception before fixture cleanup. A capture write failure stays in the transport exception; guarded finalization preserves the original workflow exception, records secondary cleanup/report errors, and invalidates an otherwise passing result on cleanup failure.
focused_validation: Actual delayed TCP listener is still rejected, recorded with its owning PID and lsof output, and both owned children are stopped.
Failed inspection records bounded stderr and the exited-process status.
Timed-out inspection preserves partial byte output and remains failed.
A failed diagnostic write preserves TransportCheckFailed and its inspector observation.
Concurrent window cleanup, daemon shutdown, daemon cleanup and result-write errors retain the original workflow exception object and attempt both child cleanups.
A cleanup failure invalidates an otherwise passing result and is recorded in result.json.
remaining: Rerun native acceptance with diagnostic capture on supported CI platforms.
